events.title: July 2023 Himachal Pradesh Beas Basin Catastrophic Flash Flood (Manali–Kullu–Bhuntar–Pandoh–Mandi)
events.summary: Held-out real disaster replay (7–11 July 2023). Interaction of a Western Disturbance and monsoon trough produced >220 mm multi-day rainfall over saturated Beas Basin catchments, causing severe flash flooding and highway washouts from Manali and Kullu through Bhuntar, Aut, Pandoh, and Mandi.

events.title: August 2023 Mandi & Balh / Uhl Sub-Basin Cloudburst & Flash Flood (11–16 August 2023)
events.summary: Secondary held-out real disaster replay (11–16 August 2023). Intense convective rainfall over already-saturated Mandi and Uhl/Pandoh slopes triggered flash floods and slope failures.
